title: PhysxVehicleTankDifferentialAPI
summary: Differential of a wheeled tank vehicle, applied on the vehicle prim: which wheels form each track and which thrust control drives it, on top of the multi-wheel differential columns. Outside the differential parse the runtime only checks that the vehicle prim lists it (or PhysxVehicleMultiWheelDifferentialAPI), to attach the parsed differential to the vehicle.

interactions.rule: The schema makes the multi-wheel differential a built-in of this API. The walkers parse a prim that lists this API as a tank differential only, reading the multi-wheel differential columns as part of it.
A tank controller requires this differential and a standard drive; the runtime also checks every wheelIndicesInTrackOrder entry against the wheel count.

notes: The parser reads and validates physxVehicleTankDifferential:numberOfWheelsPerTrack, thrustIndexPerTrack, trackToWheelIndices and wheelIndicesInTrackOrder plus the physxVehicleMultiWheelDifferential columns, and the runtime applies their live changes. They are not described yet.
